transcript.description: a graph-native session: a transcript the daemon reacts to. Its one column is computed from the entries, never stored

status.description: what the newest entry says: pending awaits the model, running awaits a call, settled has nothing to do

fork.description: this session continues another transcript from one of its entries

from.description: the entry this fork continues from: the parent's entries up to it are this transcript's prefix

entry.description: one line of a transcript; the comp beside it says what kind

text.description: what it says, when it says anything

input.description: an instruction from a person or a system; the first one is the request that starts the session

using.description: provider, model and effort: on an input it sets or switches them, on a call it records what was served

call.description: something the session reached out to: a model, or a tool the model asked for

to.description: the model or tool entity called

through.description: a model call: the last entry of the prefix it was asked with

response_id.description: a model call: the provider's anchor for continuing from here

id.description: a tool call: the provider's id for it, echoed in the result

args.description: a tool call: its arguments, as JSON

source.description: a tool call: the model call that asked for it
the model call it came from

stop.description: a mark in the transcript: the daemon performs nothing after it

error.description: an outcome the code expected and recorded: normal

exception.description: an outcome the code did not expect, whoever caused it: a defect report, not a stop
